_about: Chapter 2's lakebed ground (textures/*.jpg from tools/fetch_textures.py). unreal/lakebed_level.py builds M_Ch2_Ground from this: flat ground shows sand, where it starts to rise silt, steep banks clay. tint multiplies the photo, size = cm one tile covers, slope = where the next layer takes over (0 flat .. 1 vertical, sine of the angle).
